subject: Mutual Action Plan and sign-off cadence — Hexa POC
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@hexaretail.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan and sign-off cadence — Hexa POC

Samantha,

Thanks again for walking through the pilot MAP yesterday. Attached is MAP_v3.pdf (updated responsibilities and milestone dates). To keep the launch window on track we need to lock the final sign-off cadence and who will countersign on your side. Proposed items: 

- Approval gate (legal + procurement): redlines due by 2027-04-02
- Signature window (DocuSign): 2027-04-01 to 2027-04-04
- Target start date for POC: 2027-04-12

Ask: can you confirm the internal approvers (names/titles) and whether procurement needs an extended review? If there are any last-minute SOW clauses you expect to redline, please flag them by end of week so we route to our legal team promptly.

I copied Dev and Marissa to capture internal signatory timing on our end.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf (4 pages)
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@hexaretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@hexaretail.com
Date: 2027-03-26T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan and sign-off cadence — Hexa POC

Jordan —

Thanks for the MAP and clear timeline. High level: we are aligned on the approach, but procurement will need to run a quick redline pass (contract language on data residency and indemnity). Procurement is copied here. Two asks from our side: 

1) Can you attach a short SOC2 summary (we don't need the full report) so our security reviewer can pre-clear the platform?
2) Given our internal release calendar, we may need to push the POC start by one week (target start 2027-04-19) unless signatures complete by 2027-04-04.

Procurement, please advise on expected turnaround for redlines and the names of the signatories we should expect on Hexa's side.

Samantha Li
Head of Product, Hexa Retail
Samantha.li@hexaretail.com

Date: 2027-03-27T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan and sign-off cadence — internal

Jordan / Marissa —

Quick internal note on sequencing so we can commit to the dates Samantha asked about: 

- Legal review (our side): 48 business hours for a standard SOW redline; faster if the redline is limited to liabilities/term clauses.
- Signatories (Redwood): VP, Revenue Operations (Marissa) for commercial; CTO for the tech addendum. We can pre-authorize DocuSign so signatures can be collected within the 2027-04-01 to 2027-04-04 window.
- SOC2: I'll attach SOC2_summary.pdf to the outgoing thread today for Hexa's security reviewer.
- Contingency: if Hexa needs an extra week for internal scheduling, we can shift POC start to 2027-04-19 but prefer to keep onboarding kickoff the week after signatures.

I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and route for internal pre-approval by Monday (2027-03-29). Marissa, please confirm whether we need Exec sponsorship for any commercial concessions.

—Dev
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (2 pages)
From: procurement@hexaretail.com
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@hexaretail.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T14:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan and sign-off cadence — procurement review

Jordan / Samantha,

Procurement here. We reviewed the MAP and proposed SOW. Two notes from our side: 

1) Signatories — Hexa requires signature from Head of Procurement (A. Gomez) and CTO (D. Ramirez). Please ensure the final DocuSign envelope includes both fields.
2) Redlines — we will return a redline pass by end of day 2027-04-02. Any material changes to indemnity or data residency will require escalated legal review (may add 48–72 hours).

Assuming DocuSign is ready by 2027-04-01, we expect countersign by 2027-04-07 given our calendar. If Redwood can shorten the signature window or provide an explicit exec sponsor for any tight SLAs, flag it now.

Procurement (Hexa Retail)
procurement@hexaretail.com

Date: 2027-03-30T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan and sign-off cadence — final confirmation

Samantha / Hexa procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We are good to proceed with the following final schedule: 

- Redwood to post final SOW (with the small clarifications discussed) by 2027-03-31 EOD (we will incorporate any non-material redlines immediately).
- DocuSign envelope will go live 2027-04-01; signature window open through 2027-04-04 for Redwood and Hexa primary signers.
- Hexa procurement indicated possible countersign by 2027-04-07 — acceptable as long as signatures are in by 2027-04-07.
- Target POC start date: 2027-04-12 (if signatures complete by 2027-04-04) or fallback POC start: 2027-04-19 if Hexa needs the extra week.
- Onboarding kickoff (technical) scheduled for the week after POC start (we'll lock calendar once signatures are complete).

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/abcdef-hexapoc
Drive folder with final MAP and SOC docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/hexapoc-map

Status: GO pending receipt of signed envelope. We will monitor and ping the signatories directly if we hit the 2027-04-02 redline deadline.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: MAP_v3.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf
